measured.dryrun: bash harness/containment/test.sh on 2026-09-03: passed 25, failed 0 (re-run after the harness-01 ceremony added the caller-lines and interface-only checks). Section 1 runs the full conformance suite against the dry-run adapter, 19 of 19 checks pass, and the minimal call returns stop_reason=cancelled with a containment report of jail_mode=0700, owner_in_host_passwd=False, egress 3 made and 3 blocked, secrets_seen_inside=0, observed_from=host.
measured.swap: Conformance before with dryrun (out/before.json) and after with the second adapter (out/after.json) both exit 0, selected by configuration with no code edited between the runs; the combined run (out/swap.json) reports adapters_run=2 and every cross-adapter check holds: the containment marker read back from the running unit differs between the two technologies, the output digest and exit status are equal across them, and differs_in_execution_model is non-empty on four axes - unit_of_resource_granted, start_and_teardown_cost, processes_required_for_progress and prompt_cancellation.
measured.breakage: Two, one per skill's definition of done, both measured. A: adding 0.0.0.0/0 to the default declaration's egress allowlist in binding.json and changing nothing else makes egress_blocked 0 against egress_made 3 under both adapters, the equality assertion fails for each, and the run exits 1 while jail mode, output digest, marker and identity assertions still pass. B: raising the cancel poll interval to 30s against a 0.5s grace makes the adapter that offers cancellation report cancel_timeout with declared_gap_honoured=false and exit 1, while the single-shot adapter still passes with cancel_timeout and declared_gap_honoured=true, so a runtime that claimed cancellation and missed it is told apart from one that never claimed it.
